guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing properties (max-inline-size), display: block on replaced elements like <iframe> to avoid inline baseline gaps, flex-wrap: wrap for wrapping lists, and overflow: auto instead of overflow: hidden to handle wide tables.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100% with horizontal scrolling for the 4-column compat table, .example-embed iframe uses display: block and max-width: 100%, and .baseline-browsers inherits flex-wrap: wrap from /public/styles.css.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible semantic navigation landmarks focus visible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Place all content within landmarks (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>), use sequential headings, semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, descriptive iframe titles, and explicit :focus-visible outlines.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <footer>, captioned compat table with <th scope='col|row'>, descriptive iframe title, and 3px :focus-visible outline on .table-wrap.

guidanceConsulted.query: technical documentation typography readability inline code headings
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Apply text-wrap: balance to short headings (h1-h3) and keep code/body typography consistent with shared design tokens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: inherited shared /public/styles.css heading balance and typography tokens without inline overrides on h1, pre, code, or blockquote.
